name: Awei P10K 3 in 1 Portable Power Bank 10000mAh
description:
6 months Official warranty
Awei 10000mAh P10K 3 in 1Portable Power Bank
Specifications:
Capacity: 10000mAH
Fast charge 22.5W
Type-C input: 5v/2.8a9v/2a12v/1.5a.
Type-C output: 5V/3A 9V2.22A 12V/1.67A
USB1 output: 10v/2.25a 5v/3a9v/2a12v/1.5a.
USB2 output: 10V/2.25A, 5v/3a9v/2a12v/1.5a.
Total output: 5V/3A
Size: 145mm*69mm*16.1mm * 16.1mm.
Description:

The Awei 10000mAh P10K 3 in 1 Portable Power Bank is a versatile and reliable device that ensures you never run out of battery power on the go. With its sleek and compact design, this power bank is perfect for travel, outdoor activities, or simply as a backup power source for your devices.
This power bank features a high capacity of 10000mAh, allowing you to charge your smartphone, tablet, or other USB-powered devices multiple times before needing to recharge the power bank itself. It also comes with three different charging ports, including a USB-C port, a micro USB port, and a standard USB port, making it compatible with a wide range of devices.
The Awei 10000mAh P10K 3 in 1 Portable Power Bank is not only powerful but also safe to use. It is equipped with advanced safety features such as overcharge protection, over-discharge protection, short circuit protection, and temperature protection. This ensures that your devices are charged safely and efficiently without any risk of damage. Additionally, the power bank itself is built with high-quality materials that are durable and long-lasting.
In conclusion, the Awei 10000mAh P10K 3 in 1 Portable Power Bank is a reliable and versatile device that provides a convenient solution for charging your devices on the go. With its high capacity, multiple charging ports, and advanced safety features, this power bank is a must-have for anyone who relies on their devices throughout the day. Whether you’re traveling, camping, or simply need a backup power source, this power bank has got you covered.
